item.title: McNair Invitational at Briar’s Creek Pushes Lifetime Giving Past $4 Million for CCS Scholars
item.description: Charleston Collegiate School (CCS) is thrilled to announce that $268,000 was raised in support of student scholarships during the 10th Annual McNair Invitational hosted at The Golf Club at Briar’s Creek on February 17, 2026.

item.title: 18-Year-Old American Iva Jovic to Make Credit One Charleston Open Debut
item.description: Eighteen-year-old American Iva Jovic will make her debut at the 2026 Credit One Charleston Open, North America’s largest women’s-only professional tennis tournament, taking place March 28 – April 5, 2026, in Charleston, S.C.

item.title: How to Investigate Suspicious Activity Across Company Devices
item.description: In an era where businesses rely heavily on digital infrastructure, even small irregularities on company devices can signal serious security threats. From malware infections to insider misuse, suspicious activity can compromise sensitive data and disrupt operations if not addressed promptly. Knowing how to detect and investigate these incidents is essential for maintaining a secure and productive workplace.

item.title: Ashley Painter Launches Campaign for SC House District 117
item.description: Ashley Painter, a small business owner, former social worker, wife, and mother of two, today announced her candidacy for South Carolina House District 117 as a Democrat.

item.title: Charleston County Parks Foundation Hosting Golf Tournament Fundraiser
item.description: The Charleston County Park and Recreation Commission’s (CCPRC) nonprofit partner, the Charleston County Parks Foundation, will host a golf tournament event on Monday, April 13 to raise funds to support the foundation’s projects.
